mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.nickname, u.avatar_url FROM user_follow f JOIN user_follow r ON r.follower_id=f.followee_id AND r.followee_id=f.follower_id AND r.is_deleted=0 JOIN `user` u ON u.id=f.followee_id AND u.is_deleted=0 AND u.status=1 WHERE f.follower_id=#{userId} AND f.is_deleted=0 AND LOCATE(#{q}, u.nickname)>0 ORDER BY u.nickname, u.id

SELECT COUNT(m.id) FROM chat_member cm JOIN chat_message m ON m.conversation_id=cm.conversation_id AND m.is_deleted=0 WHERE cm.user_id=#{userId} AND cm.is_deleted=0 AND cm.hidden=0 AND m.sender_id<>#{userId} AND m.recalled=0 AND m.seq>cm.read_seq AND m.seq>cm.clear_seq
